title: Results and GPA
facts: Term GPA: Σ(grade_points × cr) ÷ total registered cr | CGPA: same across ALL courses; rounded to 2 decimals
FR: score <30%; same GPA points as F but indicates very weak performance
CGPA classification: ≥3.7=Excellent | 3.0-3.69=Very Good | 2.3-2.99=Good | 2.0-2.29=Pass | 1.0-1.69=Weak | <1.0=Very Weak
Excluded from CGPA: P/F | I | W | AU | IP | TC
Assessment — Theoretical: Midterm 25% + Coursework 25% + Final 50%
Assessment — Practical: Midterm 25% + Lab 15% + Coursework 10% + Final 50%
Assessment — Project: Coursework+practical 40% + Oral+report 60% (no written exam; 2-faculty committee, 1 external min)
Coursework includes: quizzes, assignments, theory, practical, research, attendance
Incomplete(I): must complete within 2wks after last exam of semester; else→F; counts in semester load
I under academic warning: cannot register next semester unless resolved before late registration deadline
Results approval: semester→College Council | graduation→University Council
Honor List: semester GPA≥3.3 + min load + no failures that semester
Graduation with honors: CGPA≥3.7 + no failures in entire study
Honor List + honors permanently recorded on transcript
Academic warning: CGPA<2.0 (excludes 1st ever semester + summer semesters)
Warning max load: CGPA<1.5→6cr | 1.5-<1.75→9cr | 1.75-<2.0→12cr
Warning: 2 semesters to raise CGPA≥2.0; summer counts; failure→dismissed from specialization/college
Exception: final semester student exempt from warning dismissal
Dismissed from spec: may transfer to another if accepted; else dismissed from college
Warning notification: registered letter to student's recorded address
Repeat course: latest grade counts in CGPA; cr not doubled; max 12cr repeatable total
Retry limits: up to 4 attempts; 1st fail ignored in CGPA if improved on 1st retry; 3rd/4th retry min grade=C
Graduation: CGPA≥2.0 + 146cr + field training

faq.a: Σ(grade_points × cr) ÷ total cr. Example: B(3.0)×3cr + A(4.0)×2cr = 17÷5 = 3.4
Both=0 pts. FR means score<30% (very weak). F means 0-49%.
P/F, I, W, AU, IP, TC
Complete within 2wks after last exam of semester; else becomes F
Semester GPA≥3.3 + min load + no failures that semester
CGPA≥3.7 + zero failures throughout entire study
Latest grade counts; max 12cr repeatable; up to 4 attempts; 3rd/4th attempt min grade=C
